entry.name: jit.phys.body
entry.digest: A rigid body and collision shape
entry.description: The jit.phys.body object represents a rigid body and collision shape in a physics simulation. The collision shape is either one of several simple shapes, a compound shape (combination of simple shapes), or defined by a matrix of vertices.

attributes.name: anim
attributes.description: The name of aobject to receive transform updates from.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: background
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: collisions
attributes.description: Enables and disables collision reporting out the second (dumpout) outlet.

attributes.name: color
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: damping
attributes.description: Set the linear and angular damping applied to a body in the range 0. to 1. (default 0.2 0.2). Damping can be used to simulate air resistance.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.description: Enable this body in the physics simulation (default = 1).

attributes.name: enable_sleep
attributes.description: Enable sleeping on this body, causing deactivation when linear and angular velocity are 0 (default = 0).

attributes.name: filterclass
attributes.digest: Name of this object's collision filter-class.
attributes.description: Set the name of this object's collision filter-class (default = default). Other objects must specify thename in theirlist to enable collisions with this object. Maximum allowed unique names is 10.

attributes.name: filters
attributes.digest: List of filterclass names this object collides with
attributes.description: Specify a list ofnames to enable collisions with (default = all). Possible values include,, and. Additional values include any user-specifiednames (maximum allowed = 10).

attributes.name: fontface
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: fontsize
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: force
attributes.description: Apply a force to the rigid body using a 3D worldspace vector (default = 0 0 0). Ifis enabled, the vector is converted to object space.

attributes.name: forces_relative
attributes.description: Forces relative flag will cause all forces to be converted to object space before applying (default = 0).

attributes.name: friction
attributes.description: The friction amount (opposite force) (default = 0.5). Applied when the body is in contact with another body that has friction.

attributes.name: hidden
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: hint
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: ignoreclick
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: jspainterfile
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: kinematic
attributes.digest: Kinematic flag to remove dynamics on body
attributes.description: Kinematic flag (default = 0). Use this mode to disable dynamics on the body, maintain collisions with other bodies in the world, and animate usingandattributes. This allows for a user-animated rigid-body.

attributes.name: local_scaling
attributes.description: Local scaling flag (default = 0). When enabled, theattribute will apply a local scaling transform to the collision shape. When disabled, the rigid-body is removed and re-added to the physics world for everymodification.

attributes.name: mass
attributes.description: Body mass (default = 1.). When set to 0. body dynamics are disabled, however collisions remain active.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Specifies the name of the instance (default = UID).

attributes.name: patching_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Body position in worldspace in the form x y z (default = 0. 0. 0.).

attributes.name: presentation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: presentation_rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: quat
attributes.description: Body orientation as a quaternion in the form x y z w (default = 0. 0. 0. 1.).

attributes.name: rect
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: reduce_hull
attributes.description: Enable automatic vertex reduction when bodyattribute is set to(default = 1).

attributes.name: resetpos
attributes.description: Body reset position in the form x y z (default = 0. 0. 0.). This is the worldspace position the body will return to upon receiving themessage.

attributes.name: resetquat
attributes.description: Body reset orientation as a quaternion in the form x y z w (default = 0. 0. 0. 1.). This is the orientation the body will return to upon receiving themessage.

attributes.name: restitution
attributes.description: Restitution value, or bounciness (default = 0.1). The proportion of kinetic energy preserved on impact with other rigid bodies.

attributes.name: rolling_friction
attributes.description: The rolling friction amount (opposite force for a rolling object) (default = 0.0). Applied when the body is in contact with another body that has friction.

attributes.name: rotate
attributes.description: Body orientation as angle-axis in the form angle(in degrees) x y z (default = 0. 0. 0. 1.).

attributes.name: rotate_order
attributes.description: Sets the order of rotations that are applied to the rotatexyz attribute for all child gl objects (default = auto). E.G. if set to xyz , the object is first rotated around its X axis, then Y, and finally Z. The default value, 'auto', implements yzx ordering. To replicate Max 5, use zyx . If an ob3d is bound, this will override the rotate_order inherited from its jit.gl.render context.

attributes.name: rotatexyz
attributes.description: Body orientation as Euler angles (in degrees) in the form x y z (default = 0. 0. 0.).

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: The body scaling factor in the form x y z (default = 1. 1. 1.).

attributes.name: send_scale
attributes.description: Send scale flag (default = 1). When enabled, scale values will be sent to bound objects.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: Collision shape type (default = sphere).

choices.digest: Requires a matrix of vertices. A convex hull is generated that encloses the vertices.
Requires a matrix of vertices. A concave shape is generated, allowing for hollows in the mesh shape
Requires a matrix of vertices. Handles dynamically changing mesh shapes and requires a non-moving rigid body.

attributes.name: size
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: targetname
attributes.description: The name of a target object, either an OpenGL object or a. This object will receive,, and possiblyvalues.

attributes.name: textcolor
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: textjustification
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: torque
attributes.description: Apply a torque (angular force) to the rigid body using a 3D worldspace vector (default = 0 0 0).

attributes.name: total_force
attributes.description: The total force currently applied to the rigid-body.

attributes.name: total_torque
attributes.description: The total torque currently applied to the rigid-body.

attributes.name: varname
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The current rigid-body velocity in units per second (default = 0 0 0).

attributes.name: velocity_ang
attributes.description: The current rigid-body angular velocity in radians per second (default = 0 0 0).

attributes.name: worldname
attributes.digest: Name of the context the body is bound to
attributes.description: The name of acontext this body is bound to.

messages.name: addchild
messages.digest: Add child shape to compound body
messages.description: Add to a compound body a child. Optional args are position x/y/z, quaternion x/y/z/w and scale x/y/z.
messages.argPattern: shape:symbol, x:float?, y:float?, z:float?, quat-x:float?, quat-y:float?, quat-z:float?, quat-w:float?, scale-x:float?, scale-y:float?, scale-z:float?

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Update the body forces and matrix inputs, and outputandvalues.

messages.name: getchild_dict
messages.digest: Send compound shape description as dictionary
messages.description: Send a dictionary description of the compound body child shapes out the dumpout.

messages.name: impulse
messages.description: Apply an impulse (instantaneous force) to the rigid body using a worldspace vector described by,,. Ifis enabled, the vector is converted to object space. Optional args,,describe a relative position on the body where the force is applied, otherwise it's a central force.
messages.argPattern: x:float, y:float, z:float, relative-x:float?, relative-y:float?, relative-z:float?

messages.name: removechild
messages.description: Remove the child shape atfrom a compound body.

messages.name: removechildren
messages.description: Remove all child shapes from a compound body.

messages.name: reset
messages.description: Reset body properties, and, and zero all forces.

messages.name: setchild_position
messages.description: Set the position of child shape atof a compound body.

messages.name: setchild_quat
messages.description: Set the quaternion of child shape atof a compound body.

messages.name: setchild_scale
messages.description: Set the scaling factor of child shape atof a compound body.

messages.name: setchild_shape
messages.description: Set the shape of child atof a compound body.

messages.name: setresetstate
messages.digest: Set the reset attributes to their current state
messages.description: Set theandattributes to their current state.

messages.name: torque_impulse
messages.description: Apply a torque impulse (instantaneous angular force) to the rigid body using a worldspace vector described by,,. Ifis enabled, the vector is converted to object space.

outlets.digest: connect to bind objects or position/quat values
